g.text: Prevalence sensitivity at the fixed score > 0.5 rule
Hypothetical extrapolation from 66 positive and 11 negative sites; not measured proteome precision/FDR.
Site-Finder and 14-3-3-Pred use an exploratory common cutoff; bootstrap intervals are in the CSV.
